description: Settle a consumed A2A payment token — executes the TEG transfer. Caller-only (only the authorizing agent can settle). Requires CALLER's agent JWT. Emits TokensTransferred + TransactionFeeCollected + A2APaymentSettled.

idempotency_key.description: reuse it on a retry: the route answers the first result again for 24 h instead of moving money twice (namespaced to the caller before it is sent)

task_id.description: Optional A2A task ID for audit trail

token.description: The apt_ payment token to settle

name: theprotocol_settlePayment
title: Settle Payment
